description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI class in the OrangeHRM system. It serves as an API endpoint for retrieving employee leave balance information, including methods to handle GET requests, fetch leave types, balances, and associated data, with integrated validation, pagination, and sorting. It facilitates interaction with leave balance data within the OrangeHRM HRM system's leave module.
